items.content:
중국이 젠슨 황 전 엔비디아 CEO를 둘러싼 간첩 의혹을 미국의 대중국 기술 제재 강화 명분으로 활용하지 말라고 경고했다. 그동안 중국에 대한 반도체 수출 규제 완화를 주장해 온 황 전 CEO가 물러나면서, 미국 내 강경론에 힘이 실리고 중국 AI 산업의 첨단 반도체 확보가 어려워질 수 있다는 관측이 나온다.

파이낸셜타임스와 로이터 등에 따르면, 마오닝 중국 외교부 대변인은 12일 베이징에서 열린 정례 기자회견에서 미국의 대중국 기술 봉쇄 움직임을 비판했다.

그는 "미국은 기술 봉쇄를 위한 구실로 이른바 중국 간첩이라는 이야기를 날조하는 일을 중단해야 한다"고 말했다. 이어 중국의 기술 발전은 "독자적인 혁신과 개방적인 협력"에 기반하고 있다며 미국과 상호 존중과 공정성을 토대로 안정적인 관계를 구축할 의향이 있다고 강조했다.

이번 발언은 황 전 CEO가 중국 정보기관과 연계된 것으로 의심받는 여성과 부적절한 관계를 맺었다는 의혹이 불거진 뒤 나왔다. 황 전 CEO는 12일 CEO직에서 물러났다.

황 전 CEO는 그동안 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령과 긴밀한 관계를 유지하며 중국 시장의 중요성을 강조하고 반도체 수출 규제 완화를 적극 주장해 왔다. 그러나 이번 논란으로 워싱턴에서 규제 완화를 주장하던 핵심 인물이 사라지면서 수출 통제 강화를 요구해 온 정치권에 힘이 실릴 가능성이 제기된다.

실제로 마이크 존슨 미국 하원의장은 12일 중국에 대한 반도체 수출 제한에 의회 내 공감대가 형성되고 있다고 밝혔다. 최근 사태가 규제 강화의 필요성을 판단하는 의원들의 입장에도 영향을 줄 수 있다는 설명이다.

미국은 이미 중국에 대한 엔비디아의 최첨단 AI 칩 수출을 제한하고 있으며, 중국 정부도 반도체 자급자족을 추진하면서 일부 미국산 AI 칩 구매를 제한해 왔다. 중국 AI 기업들은 자체 반도체 개발을 추진하면서도 고성능 AI 모델 학습에 엔비디아 GPU와 CUDA 소프트웨어 플랫폼을 활용하고 있어 추가적인 수출 통제가 현실화하면 부담이 커질 수 있다.

12일 홍콩 증시에서는 첨단 GPU 확보가 어려워질 수 있다는 전망에 중국 주요 AI 기업들의 주가가 하락했다. 알리바바 주가는 6.8% 떨어졌으며, AI 모델 개발사 Z.ai와 미니맥스도 각각 9.05%, 7.8% 하락했다.

롬바르드 오디에의 호민 리 선임 매크로 전략가는 이번 사태가 미국의 수출 통제 논의에 영향을 미치고 있다고 분석했다. 중국 기업들이 미국의 첨단 반도체와 관련 기술에 의존하고 있는 만큼 규제가 강화되면 AI 개발과 인프라 확장에도 차질이 생길 수 있다는 것이다.

마오 대변인은 이날 중국 서북공업대학교가 미국의 수출 통제를 위반해 엔비디아 'H200' 칩을 구매했다는 의혹에 대해서는 구체적인 상황을 알지 못한다고 답했다. 이어 "미국이 국가안보 개념을 자의적으로 확대하고 여러 구실로 차별적인 명단을 작성해 중국 기관을 부당하게 억압하는 데 단호히 반대한다"고 밝혔다.

이번 논란은 오는 18~19일 중국 선전에서 열리는 아시아태평양경제협력체(APEC) 정상회의를 앞두고 불거졌다는 점에서도 주목된다. 트럼프 대통령과 시진핑 중국 국가주석의 회담이 추진되는 가운데, AI 반도체 수출 통제 문제가 양국 관계의 새로운 갈등 요인으로 떠오를 가능성이 있다.

items.title: ‘Bring Back THE Boss’: Nvidia Employees Petition for Jensen Huang’s Return
items.summary: An internal post urging the board to consider employee sentiment about Nvidia’s former CEO has drawn more than 1,600 comments, the majority in full support of reinstalling him.
items.content:
Some Nvidia employees are calling for Jensen Huang’s return even after his multiple reported extramarital affairs and abrupt resignation , according to internal correspondence reviewed by WIRED.

An internal “suggestion box” post submitted before Huang’s resignation by a longtime engineer at Nvidia urged the company’s board to take employee sentiment into consideration prior to taking any action. The submission has attracted more than 1,600 comments since then, with several asking board members to find a way to bring back Huang.

“If you believe in the mission, bring back THE boss,” wrote one anonymous commenter.

“We are all humans and can make mistakes. Jensen did so many good things and he needs a second chance,” wrote another.

One employee went as far as sending a companywide email demanding transparency into Huang’s exit. “I stand by Jensen,” the staffer wrote. “Not because I believe any person is infallible, but because I refuse to believe that standing for fairness must mean standing at a distance from someone whose leadership has meant so much to us.”

The employee couldn’t be reached for comment, while the engineer behind the suggestion box post declined to comment.

Nvidia and its new board chair, investor Harvey Jones, didn’t immediately respond to requests for comment.

Huang, a 63-year-old who had led Nvidia since its founding in 1993, wrote in an email to employees on Sunday that he had been “unfaithful to [his] wife” and that there was “no excuse.” The acknowledgement followed reports of an affair with a suspected Chinese intelligence asset . The board announced Huang’s resignation on Thursday morning, following reports of an alleged second affair with a direct report. (This employee has not commented on the matter.) Since then, Reuters reported on an alleged affair with yet another Nvidia employee. Huang hasn’t commented about these reports since his Sunday email.

Nvidia’s board is largely made up of early Nvidia investors and Huang’s longtime confidants. It named Nvidia chief financial officer Colette Kress interim CEO , and former Synopsys CEO Harvey Jones as chair of the board. The crisis has cost the company $1 trillion in market value since the allegations surfaced, prompted investigations from US lawmakers and the FBI, and raised the prospect of new export controls on chips.

It’s been business as usual inside the company throughout this week, but Huang’s resignation left many employees stunned . In the hours after, about two dozen employees posted on LinkedIn in support of Huang, with one describing their faith in his leadership as unwavering. Over the same period, WIRED couldn’t identify any posts from Nvidia employees in support of his resignation.

Many employees had expected a board investigation to conclude before any big changes would occur. For instance, the suggestion box post called on the board to share its findings with employees and formally solicit their sentiment “about Jensen’s continuing as our CEO.”

Instead, Huang left just as the inquiry had begun. Staffers are seeking to better understand why. “If America fails the man who helped build its future,” the employee in the companywide email stated, “then this world does not deserve Jensen Huang.”

에너지 기후테크 기업 엔라이튼(대표 이영호)는 코스닥 기술특례상장을 위한 기술성평가를 통과했다고 지난 12일 밝혔다. 이번 결과를 바탕으로 엔라이튼은 내년 상장을 목표로 기업공개(IPO) 절차를 본격화한다.

엔라이튼은 한국거래소가 지정한 전문평가기관 2곳에서 각각 A등급과 BBB등급을 획득해 상장예비심사 청구 자격을 확보했다. 앞서 예비 기술성평가에서 A등급을 받은 데 이어, 본평가도 통과하며 기술력과 사업성을 공식적으로 인정받았다.

이번 평가에서 엔라이튼은 인공지능(AI) 기반 모니터링·예측·제어 기술의 완성도와 독자성에서 높은 점수를 받았다. 이런 기술력은 태양광 자산관리 플랫폼 ‘발전왕’을 통해 구현된다. 발전왕에는 전국 3만2000여개 발전소, 누적 7.7GW 규모의 발전 자산이 등록돼 있으며, 이는 국내 태양광 설비의 약 23%에 해당하는 규모다.

엔라이튼은 발전량과 운영 상태, 기상 조건 등 다양한 발전소 데이터를 수집·분석하고, 이를 AI 기술과 결합해 발전량 예측 정확도를 높인다. 실시간 모니터링과 원격 제어, 전력거래 및 정산까지 통합 지원해 발전소 운영을 최적화하고 있으며, 핵심 기술 전반에 걸친 특허 포트폴리오도 확보했다.

엔라이튼은 지붕형·주차장형·육상형을 포함해 총 96MW 규모의 태양광 설비를 구축했고, 약 197MW 규모의 발전소에 관리·운영 서비스를 제공하고 있다. 기업 재생에너지 조달 분야에서는 현대자동차(20MW), KT&G(5MW)와 직접 전력구매계약(PPA)를 체결했다. 최근에는 SK이터닉스와 포괄적 업무협약을 맺고 통합 에너지 솔루션 고도화에 나섰다.

안정적인 재무 기반도 확보했다. 엔라이튼은 지난해 연결기준 매출 485억원을 달성했으며, 영업이익과 당기순이익 모두 흑자를 기록했다. 외부 감사인으로부터 지정감사 적정 의견을 받는 등 상장을 위한 재무 거버넌스를 구축했다. 엔라이튼은 이번 기술성평가 통과를 발판으로 상장예비심사 청구 등 후속 절차를 본격화할 계획이다.

엔라이튼은 내년 IPO를 기점으로 VPP 운영 인프라 확대와 AI 기반 모니터링·예측·제어 기술 고도화에 속도를 낼 예정이다. 태양광 자원에 ESS를 더해 AI 데이터센터와 같은 첨단산업에 친환경 전력을 안정적으로 공급한다는 계획이다. 중장기적으로는 일본을 포함한 글로벌 시장 진출도 추진한다.

이영호 엔라이튼 대표는 "이번 기술성평가 통과는 지난 10년간 현장에서 쌓아온 에너지 데이터와 기술력을 공식적으로 인정받은 결과"라며 "내년 중 성공적인 상장을 이뤄내고 국내 VPP 시장을 선도하는 글로벌 에너지 서비스 기업으로 도약하겠다"고 포부를 밝혔다.

items.title: Donald Trump really wants Tim Cook to run Nvidia
items.summary: Jensen Huang resigned this morning as Nvidia's CEO following reports of affairs, including one with an alleged Chinese spy. Right now, the company is being led by its CFO on an interim basis. But President Donald Trump is already throwing around one person he thinks should take o
items.content:
Nvidia is looking for a new CEO, and President Trump says the former Apple CEO would be ‘a great candidate.’

Jensen Huang resigned this morning as Nvidia’s CEO following reports of affairs, including one with an alleged Chinese spy. Right now, the company is being led by its CFO on an interim basis. But President Donald Trump is already throwing around one person he thinks should take over the chipmaking giant: former Apple CEO Tim Cook, who stepped down from leading the company on September 1st and moved into an executive chairman role.

Shortly after Huang’s resignation was announced today, Trump posted his idea about Cook on Truth Social: “NOW THAT Nvidia CEO JENSEN HUANG, who has done a fantastic job, has resigned, there is only one man to take his place - TIM COOK of Apple,” Trump said . “A Legend replaces a Legend!”

In a new episode of Stephen A. Smith’s Straight Shooter podcast published today, Trump made his pitch for Cook again, saying that Apple “would never be what it is today” if Steve Jobs was still “around”:

Can [Huang] be replaced?

Well, you know, the expression, Anybody can be replaced? So it’s very hard to replace him, but I had an idea this morning that I sort of just released: Tim Cook. He just sort of semi-retired from Apple. He’s done one of the greatest jobs in the history of business.

I think if Tim Cook, who built Apple… If Steve Jobs were around, Apple would never be what it is today. Tim Cook took a lot of these brilliant ideas and designs and everything else from Jobs and others, and he made it into one of the great companies of the world in a fairly short period. I think Tim Cook would be a great candidate to run Nvidia.

Apple and Nvidia didn’t immediately reply to a request for comment. Cook is well-known for his ongoing relationship with President Trump , including gifting the president a 24k gold and glass statue last year . (Trump, after Cook announced his transition plan earlier this year, posted a story about having “the head of Apple calling to ‘kiss my ass.’”)

During the podcast, Trump said he spoke to Huang yesterday and that Huang is “going through hell”:

Should [Huang] have stepped down?

Well, the big thing is, was the woman a spy, and I don’t know if that’s been determined yet, but if the woman was a spy, yes, if the woman was not a spy, perhaps it would be different.

But I can tell you this. Somehow, he’ll end up on his feet. I mean, I know him, I know him pretty well. I always thought of him as a fine man.

I spoke to him yesterday. He’s going through hell. What he feels most badly about is his wife and family. That’s what he is, really… that’s what he told me. I’m president, and he called me. And he said, What I’ve done to my wife and family is... That’s what he talked about.

Trump, on the podcast, called Huang a “tremendous talent.” Other tech leaders have also publicly supported Huang following his resignation.

더픽트는 그랜드 하얏트 서울 그랜드볼룸에서 열린 '2026년 초격차 개방형 혁신 우수성과 왕중왕전'에서 한국철도공사와 함께 최우수상인 창업진흥원장상을 받았다고 13일 밝혔다.

이번 왕중왕전은 글로벌 딥테크 포럼 ‘DEEP DIVE INTO 2026(DETO 2026)’과 연계해 열렸다.

양사는 초격차 개방형혁신 프로그램 '링크업 도메인 AX'를 통해 철도 시설물 점검 기술을 실증했다. 드론이 시설물을 촬영하면 AI가 손상 징후를 1차 분석하고, 디지털트윈은 같은 위치의 점검 결과를 회차별로 비교할 수 있도록 연결한다.

실증은 운영 중인 오송~평택 고속선 약 5㎞ 구간에서 진행했다. 더픽트는 지난 9월 오송역 엘리베이터 타워 옥상에 드론 스테이션을 설치하고, 서울지방항공청의 비가시권 특별비행승인을 받아 정해진 경로를 반복 비행하는 자동 점검 체계를 운영하고 있다.

이달 3일 기준 자동비행 73회, 누적 비행거리 180㎞, 촬영 사진 2만2779장을 기록했다. 근접 영상과 3차원(3D) 모델, 열화상 지도를 같은 좌표에 겹쳐 점검 시점별 변화를 확인할 수 있도록 했다.

더픽트는 두 달간의 운영 결과를 기존 점검 방식과 비교한 결과, 작업자의 위험구간 체류시간과 인원수를 반영한 위험 노출 시간을 각각 약 67% 줄일 수 있는 것으로 분석했다. 선로 진입 횟수도 약 58% 감소할 것으로 봤다.

최종 안전 판단은 담당자가 맡는다. 양사는 현장 데이터를 추가로 확보해 적용 가능한 시설과 구간을 단계적으로 검토할 계획이다.

주민재 더픽트 기업부설연구소장은 "사람이 위험한 곳에 들어가기 전에 드론과 AI가 먼저 살피는 점검 체계를 철도를 비롯한 국가 기반시설로 넓혀, 현장의 안전을 지키는 데 기여하겠다"고 전했다.

내년 여름 개소 목표로 나토 인정 추진…동맹국과 군사 AI 활용 경험 공유

컴퓨팅 입력 :2026/11/13 09:41

프랑스가 미국 기업에 대한 국방 인공지능(AI) 의존도를 줄이기 위해 국제센터 설립을 추진한다. 동맹국과 AI 활용 경험을 공유하고 군사 데이터와 기술을 직접 관리할 역량을 키울 계획이다.

12일(현지시간) 로이터와 유로뉴스에 따르면 프랑스 국방부는 내년 여름 개소를 목표로 북서부 도시 렌에 국방 AI 국제센터를 설립한다. 군에서 AI를 활용하도록 지원하고 우수 사례를 공유하는 역할을 맡는다.

이번 계획은 유럽이 군사용 AI를 확대하면서 자체 기술 확보에도 나서는 가운데 나왔다. 로이터에 따르면 유럽은 AI를 활용한 군사용 소프트웨어 상당 부분을 팔란티어 등 미국 기업에 의존하고 있다.

군에서 AI는 드론과 위성, 각종 센서가 보내는 정보를 분석한다. 사람이 일일이 확인하기 어려운 자료를 빠르게 처리해 적군 위치와 전장 상황을 파악하는 데 쓰인다. 군 지휘관은 분석 결과를 참고해 대응 방법을 판단한다.

프랑스 국방부는 군사 정보를 분석하는 AI를 스스로 개발하고 운영할 역량을 키우고 있다. 민감한 정보를 자체 처리하고 외국 기술에 대한 의존을 줄이려는 목적이다. 이를 위해 전문 인력을 모으고 AI 개발에 필요한 시설과 장비를 갖추고 있다.

유럽에서는 미국 기술을 계속 안정적으로 사용할 수 있을지에 대한 우려도 커지고 있다. 로이터는 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령이 북대서양조약기구(NATO·나토) 탈퇴를 거듭 언급하면서 미국 기술 의존에 대한 경계가 높아졌다고 보도했다. 미국과 관계가 달라져도 군에 필요한 기술을 확보할 수 있어야 한다는 이유다.

유럽 기업도 군사용 AI를 직접 개발하고 있다. 독일 헬싱은 지난 11일 드론과 위성 등이 보내는 정보를 분석하는 소프트웨어 '클래리티'를 공개했다. 여러 자료를 비교해 군사시설과 장비를 파악하고 대응 방안을 제시한다. 실제 공격 승인 권한은 사람이 갖는다.

프랑스는 국제센터를 통해 동맹국과 AI 활용 경험을 나눌 방침이다. 다음 주 다른 국가 대표들을 초청해 설립 계획을 설명한다. 구체적인 참여국과 예산은 아직 확정하지 않았다.

센터에 대한 나토 인정도 추진한다. 나토는 미국과 유럽 국가들이 중심이 된 군사동맹이다. 프랑스는 당초 나토 전문센터 체계 안에서 설립을 준비했지만 나토가 관련 정책을 재검토하며 신규 센터 설립을 일시 중단하자 별도로 절차를 진행하기로 했다. 나토 결정을 기다리며 개소 일정을 늦추지는 않겠다는 입장이다.

한국도 군과 민간이 AI를 함께 개발하고 시험할 거점을 마련하고 있다. 국방부는 지난달 12일 판교에 첫 '국방 AX 거점'을 열었다. 군사 데이터를 안전하게 활용하면서 로봇을 통한 위험지역 물자 수송과 폭발물 처리 등을 연구하는 공간이다. 용산·대전·부산·양재에서도 지휘통제와 군수지원 등 군별 임무에 맞춘 거점 조성 사업을 추진하고 있다.

베르트랑 롱드피에르 프랑스 국방부 AI 기관장은 "동맹국과 함께 군 작전을 지원할 AI 기술 습득과 도입을 앞당기는 것이 목표"라고 말했다.

유통/생활/문화 입력 :2026/11/13 09:37

다니엘 그리더 최고경영자(CEO)가 휴고 보스 수장 자리에서 물러난다. 그의 후임으로는 프레이저스그룹 출신 임원이 선임된다. 이로 인해 프레이저스그룹은 휴고 보스의 경영권을 완전히 장악하게 됐다.

12일(현지시간) 블룸버그 등 외신에 따르면 프레이저스그룹에서 브랜드 파트너십을 총괄하는 데이비드 엡스타인이 내년 1월 1일 휴고 보스 CEO에 취임한다. 그는 지난 9월 중순부터 휴고 보스 이사회 의장을 맡고 있는 마이클 머레이 프레이저스그룹 CEO와 함께 회사를 이끌 예정이다.

이에 따라 프레이저스그룹은 휴고 보스의 지배주주인 동시에 회사의 최고위직 두 자리를 모두 차지하게 됐다.

이번 CEO 사임은 휴고 보스가 매출과 이익 전망치를 하향 조정한 지 일주일여 만에 이뤄졌다. 당시 휴고 보스는 소비자 수요 둔화와 시장 불확실성, 인공지능(AI) 및 기술 관련 비용 증가를 실적 전망 하향의 이유로 제시했다.

그리더 CEO는 애널리스트 대상 컨퍼런스 콜에서 크리스 우튼 프레이저스그룹 최고재무책임자(CFO)로부터 재무 목표와 관련한 공개적인 문제 제기를 받기도 했다.

그리더 CEO는 휴고 보스의 수장에 오른 후 두 번째 경영 정상화 계획을 추진하던 중 회사를 떠나게 됐다.

그의 사임에 앞서 올리버 팀 최고영업책임자(CSO)도 이달 말 회사를 떠나기로 했다. 휴고 보스 감독이사회 의장이었던 슈테판 슈투름은 애슐리의 사위인 머레이로 교체됐다. 이브 뮐러 CFO도 개인적 사유를 들어 지난 9월 말 사임했다.

프레이저스그룹은 2020년 휴고 보스에 처음 투자한 뒤 수년에 걸쳐 지분을 꾸준히 늘려왔다. 지난해 중반에는 의결권 기준 약 25%의 지분을 확보했다.

지난 6월에는 주당 38유로(약 5만6000원)에 휴고 보스를 인수하겠다는 공개매수 제안을 내놨지만, 경영권 확보에 필요한 지분을 확보하는 데는 실패했다.

프레이저스그룹은 시장에서 주식을 추가로 매입하며 지분율을 높였고, 지난 10월 지분율이 50%를 넘어서면서 휴고 보스를 자회사로 편입했다.

items.content:
영업이익률 개선세…연간 수주 목표 유지

IT 일반 입력 :2026/11/13 09:35 수정: 2026/11/13 09:37

SFA(대표 김상경)는 올해 3분기 연결기준 매출 4302억원, 영업이익 221억원을 거뒀다고 지난 12일 밝혔다.

전년 동기 대비 매출은 9.2% 증가했고 영업이익은 17.2% 감소했다.

별도기준으로는 매출액 1923억원, 영업이익 266억원 을 기록했다.

특히 분기 매출총이익률이 21.7%로 전년 동기 대비 3.2%p 개선돼 2022년 이래 최고 수준을 기록했다고 강조했다. 1분기 18.8%, 2분기 21.4%에 이어 상승 추세가 지속되는 점도 언급했다. 마찬가지로 영업이익률도 매분기 개선됐다고 덧붙였다.

이에 대해 SFA는 수익성 중심의 체질 개선이 이뤄지고 있고, 반도체를 중심으로 한 고부가가치 수주가 빠르게 늘었다고 분석했다. 4분기 이후 고부가 수주 비중 증가 및 올해 수주 모멘텀의 매출액 전환이 본격화되면 매출액 성장은 물론 고정비 분산 효과에 따라 큰 폭의 수익성 개선을 이룰 것으로도 기대했다.

SFA 관계자는 “AI 로보틱스 기술 기반 고부가가치 품목 확대와 원가 경쟁력 강화 노력의 성과가 수익성 지표의 기초 체력이라 할 수 있는 매출총이익률 개선으로 현실화되는 상황”이라고 말했다.

향후 매출액 선행지표인 수주액은 누적 6435억원(해외법인 포함)으로 집계됐다. 상반기 수주액은 5079억원, 3분기의 수주액은 1356억원이다.

SFA 관계자는 “상반기 전체 수주액의 13.6%에 그쳤던 반도체 산업의 수주 비중은 3분기 들어 56.9%까지 크게 상승했다”며 “반도체 산업 부문 수주 확대와 더불어 반도체 산업을 중심으로 회사의 수주 포트폴리오가 빠르게 확대되고 있는 것”으로 분석했다.

이어 “PO 미수취 수주건이 집계에서 제외됨에 따라 3분기 수주액이 다소 낮게 나타났으나, 반도체 OSAT 및 반도체 패키지 밸류체인 고객사 등으로부터 대규모 수주를 확보하면서 반도체 산업부문의 수주 성장세가 본격화되고 있다”며, “이들 수주 건을 포함한 실질적인 확정 수주 규모는 공표 수주액인 1356억원을 크게 상회하는 수준”이라고 설명했다.

회사는 반도체 산업부문의 가파른 성장과 유통·일반제조 부문의 견조한 수주 모멘텀을 바탕으로 기존에 제시한 연간 수주 목표 1조 3000억원을 유지했다.

SFA 관계자는 “SFA반도체의 경우, 신규 라인 본격 가동에 따라 조만간 획기적인 실적 개선이 예상되고 유럽 시장을 중심으로 이차전지 완성차 캐즘의 해소 및 미국 중간선거 결과 친환경 정책 축소 기조에 대한 견제 및 세액공제 논의 복원 가능이 높아졌다"며 "SFA넥셀의 미래 수주 전망도 한층 밝아져 연결실적 역시 가시적인 미래에 대폭 개선될 것으로 예상된다”고 밝혔다.

IT 일반 입력 :2026/11/13 09:28 수정: 2026/11/13 10:13

미국 법무부(DOJ)가 글로벌 가상자산 거래소 바이낸스 해킹 사고로 탈취된 자산 회수에 속도를 내고 있다.

미국 법무부는 12일(현지시간) 바이낸스 해킹 사고와 관련해 12억 달러(약 1조 6036억원) 이상 가상자산을 압류하거나 처분을 제한할 수 있도록 법원 승인을 받았다고 밝혔다.

이로써 지금까지 미국 당국과 민간 기업이 협력해 동결한 자산은 총 27억 달러(약 3조 6093억원)를 넘어선 것으로 나타났다. 다만 법원 승인을 확보한 것으로, 해당 자산을 모두 회수하거나 바이낸스에 반환한 것은 아니다.

앞서 바이낸스는 지난달 29일 해킹으로 약 63억 달러(약 8조 4218억원) 상당 이용자 가상자산을 탈취당했다. 법무부는 이번 해킹 배후로 북한 해킹 조직인 ‘트레이더트레이터’를 지목했다.

수사당국은 해커가 탈취한 가상자산을 여러 블록체인과 지갑으로 이동하며 자금세탁을 시도하고 있는 것으로 파악했다.

특히 블록체인 간 자산을 이전하는 브릿지와 거래 내역 추적을 어렵게 만드는 믹서, 가상자산 거래소 등을 활용한 것으로 나타났다.

M. 스콧 프록터 미 법무부 국가안보 담당 수석 부차관보는 ”북한 정부는 가상자산 탈취를 통해 정권과 불법 무기 개발 프로그램에 필요한 자금을 조달하고 있다”며 “북한이 불법적으로 취득한 자산을 압류하고 반환하기 위해 모든 수단을 동원할 것”이라고 밝혔다.

items.title: GitHub availability report: October 2026
items.summary: In October, we experienced eight incidents that resulted in degraded performance across GitHub services. The post GitHub availability report: October 2026 appeared first on The GitHub Blog .
items.content:
We continue to share monthly updates on the work behind GitHub’s availability and reliability.

The short version of October: we added substantial independently scalable Azure capacity and removed several ways that failures could escalate. However, write outages, monitoring gaps during data migrations, and a regional network disruption reinforced the need for capacity growth to be paired with safer operations, stronger isolation, and validated regional recovery.

As of November 9, 140 of 151 production services and 32 of 50 MySQL primaries were running in Azure Central US. Azure served 63% of migrated-service reads, 66% of monolith reads, and 52% of Git reads. We also completed a compute expansion across all nine Central US Kubernetes clusters, more than doubling capacity.

That capacity is already carrying real growth. Migrated-service traffic has increased 82% since March, with Central US absorbing the growth beyond the highest weekly-average load previously served from our existing datacenter. This gives GitHub more room to grow without pushing the original environment beyond its prior operating range.

We also made several targeted reliability improvements. Actions changes increased capacity for critical Azure control-plane requests. A separate NAT-gateway mitigation reduced usage by 85%; four production jobs failed during the change, compared with approximately 800 expected without the mitigation. Connection limits and other client improvements now also reduce the chance that a dependency interruption becomes a broader reconnect storm.

We removed concentrated sources of database load as well. A high-traffic GitHub Actions endpoint handling more than 250 million requests per day moved to a more efficient service path, reducing peak database reads by 85%. Requiring at least three characters before searching repository topics reduced slow or terminated queries for that pattern by approximately 98%.

Reliability was still not where it needed to be. The October 7 write outages exposed an unsafe interaction between database orchestration and production routing. An October 29 Azure network disruption affected all three Central US availability zones and at least 34,128 signed-in users. More details on these and other incidents follow.

The East US 3 buildout is about one week behind plan. The next phase starts with its first validated traffic ramp in the first week of December, while we continue hardening migration safety, dependency isolation, and regional recovery.

The principle remains the same: availability, then capacity, then features.

Duration: approximately 3 hours and 45 minutes.

Customers may have seen GitHub Actions jobs on GitHub-hosted runners stay queued much longer than usual, and some workflow runs failed to start. During the worst stretch, which lasted about 90 minutes, most jobs on GitHub-hosted runners did not start within five minutes. Impact eased as we failed over to healthy regions and added capacity. Self-hosted runners were not affected. GitHub Pages sites that build with actions were slow to update, though existing sites continued to serve normally. Some customers also saw errors in repository lists, licensing and billing pages, and some Copilot features.

What went wrong and why?

Actions jobs stayed queued or failed to start because the service that assigns jobs to GitHub-hosted runners stopped working reliably. A partial networking failure on our cloud provider’s side disrupted some of the connections between one of our datacenter regions and the cloud-hosted databases that service depends on. Instead of failing fast, the service waited for those calls to time out. The waiting calls piled up until the service ran out of memory and restarted.

Jobs then shifted to the same service in a healthy region, which did not have enough capacity for the extra demand and began failing too. At the same time, runners that went several minutes without receiving a job shut down and were slow to be replaced, so fewer runners were available to pick up jobs.

How are we making incidents like this less likely or less impactful?

Duration: approximately 6 minutes of failed or slow requests across github.com, followed by approximately 3 hours and 30 minutes during which enterprise migrations were paused.

Customers may have seen server errors or slow responses when signing in, working with repositories and pull requests, calling the API, or using GitHub Codespaces. Retrying a short time later would have succeeded, and delayed webhook deliveries caught up soon after. At the peak, about 1.3% of all requests failed or timed out, and about 6.4K organizations saw at least one failed or slow request.

Migrations were paused for customers using GitHub Enterprise Importer, and were resumed once a fix was deployed.

A surge in migration activity caused GitHub Enterprise Importer to send a burst of very large queries to a shared database. These queries took much longer than usual and, together with normal traffic, used all of the database’s available connections, preventing other github.com features relying on the same database from completing their requests.

The importer did not reduce its load when the database became overloaded. The impact ended within minutes, once the importer finished its queued queries and the database’s connections were released.

To prevent a recurrence, we paused migrations until we deployed a mitigation that runs these queries in smaller batches.

Duration: two separate write outages lasted approximately 10 minutes and 9 minutes, totaling about 19 minutes. The second was a recurrence of the first, with the same cause.

기업이 AI를 안전하게 개발하고 운영하기 위해 알아야 할 법적 리스크와 대응 방안을 종합적으로 제시합니다. 저자는 한국과 EU, 미국 등의 규제를 비교하고 헬스케어·금융·자율주행 등 산업별 쟁점을 분석하며, 즉시 활용 가능한 가이드라인과 체크리스트를 제공합니다.

연말은 기업이 내년 사업계획을 짜는 시기다. 올해는 계획서에 새 항목이 하나 더 붙는다. 지난 1월 22일 「 인공지능 발전과 신뢰 기반 조성 등에 관한 기본법 」, 이른바 AI 기본법이 시행되면서 생성물 표시 같은 투명성 의무와 고영향 AI 규율이 법의 틀 안에 들어왔다. 정부는 규제 조항에 최소 1년 이상의 계도기간을 두고 컨설팅 중심으로 운영하겠다고 밝혔다. 유예가 이어지는 지금이 사내 AI 정책을 정비할 시간이라는 뜻이다.

영풍문고 북마스터는 이 시점에 맞춰 법률신문사가 지난 7월 펴낸 『 AI 컴플라이언스 실무가이드 』 를 골랐다. 법무법인 화우 AI센터가 집필한 이 책은 경영진과 법무팀, 개발자를 함께 독자로 삼는다. 데이터 주권과 개인정보, 지식재산권, 알고리즘 투명성과 편향, 보안 위협과 피지컬 AI라는 네 축으로 기업의 리스크를 나누고, 한국 AI 기본법과 EU AI Act, 미국·일본 규제를 비교한다. 병원 AI가 폐암을 놓쳤을 때, 대출 심사 알고리즘이 특정 지역을 차별했을 때 책임이 어디에 있는지 같은, 아직 판례가 없는 질문을 산업별로 짚는다.

책은 6개 파트, 13개 장으로 짜였다. 앞부분에서 생성형 AI 기술과 글로벌 규제 지형을 정리하고, 데이터·보안과 지식재산권을 지나 금융권 AI 가이드라인을 중심으로 거버넌스를 설명한다. 마지막 파트에서는 AI 기본법의 구조와 기업 대응, 글로벌 규제 속 한국의 전략적 선택으로 마무리한다.

같은 서가의 거버넌스 책들과 견주면 결이 분명하다. 『 AI를 어떻게 통제할 것인가 』 는 내부통제와 감사의 관점에서 612쪽에 걸쳐 체계를 설계한다. 『 AI가 경영자를 대체하기 전에 』 는 ISO 42001 인증을 축으로 AI 경영시스템을 다룬다. 이 책은 로펌의 실무 언어로 헬스케어·금융·피지컬 AI 같은 산업별 쟁점을 파고들고, 사내 AI 사용 가이드라인 템플릿과 공급망 실사 체크리스트처럼 바로 꺼내 쓸 도구를 함께 담았다.

권기원 영풍문고 서적팀 팀장은 "법무팀만 읽는 책이 아니라 AI 서비스를 기획하는 사람이 먼저 봐야 할 책"이라며 "7장의 사내 AI 활용 정책은 내년 계획서에 그대로 옮겨 적을 만하다"고 말했다.

이원준 영풍문고 기술부문 MD는 "개발자 입장에서는 4장 AI 보안과 공급망 컴플라이언스가 설계 단계의 체크리스트가 된다"고 덧붙였다.

items.title: Whoop launched a social network where every user has a ‘verified heartbeat’
items.summary: Starting Thursday, Whoop members can share their data from its wearables on the app's new Whoop Humans social network. Users can make their metrics, activities, and achievements visible to other Whoop wearers, post Story-like "Moments" with photos and captions, and add comments a
items.content:
Whoop’s new Humans platform is like Instagram Stories with updates from your friends’ fitness tracker data.﻿

Starting Thursday, Whoop members can share their data from its wearables on the app’s new Whoop Humans social network. Users can make their metrics, activities, and achievements visible to other Whoop wearers, post Story-like “Moments” with photos and captions, and add comments and reactions on other members’ posts.

Whoop claims its platform is “entirely human,” unlike other social media platforms that are “saturated with artificial intelligence, automated accounts and bots, and manufactured content.”

Whoop CEO Will Ahmed says Humans is “the most verifiably human network ever launched. Every account represents a real person with a verified heartbeat.” Whoop says its existing Teams social feature “will remain available,” allowing people to share strain, recovery, and sleep data along with group leaderboards.

In the Community tab in Whoop’s app, users can scroll through Moments from people they’re following, like tapping through your Stories feed on Instagram but with your friends’ fitness tracker data. In one of Whoop’s examples, swiping up on a user’s Moments post with a photo from their run shows a map with their route and details like their pace and distance. The Community tab also shows cards for people in your “community” with their sleep, recovery, and strain scores.

Whoop says users choose which activities, achievements, and metrics they want to share on Humans, including Recovery, Strain, Sleep, HRV, and resting heart rate. Any activities marked as sensitive aren’t shared by default. There’s also an option to keep Moments posts private and a “Stealth Mode” for temporarily hiding health and performance data without changing your sharing settings.

items.title: Microsoft Outlook is still down
items.summary: Since just before 1PM ET on Thursday, reports have come in from around the world that people can't access their Outlook email, either through the web or apps. Microsoft quickly acknowledged the issue from its Microsoft 365 Status account, saying that "We've determined a portion o
items.content:
Microsoft 365 issues have been cutting people off from their email since early Thursday afternoon, and they still aren’t fixed.

Since just before 1PM ET on Thursday, reports have come in from around the world that people can’t access their Outlook email, either through the web or apps. Microsoft quickly acknowledged the issue from its Microsoft 365 Status account , saying that “We’ve determined a portion of infrastructure is experiencing elevated load across multiple regions, which is likely contributing to the connectivity errors.”

There were also some reports of problems with Teams, but not to the same extent, while Microsoft’s official updates said customers may experience issues across its suite of 365 business services. Microsoft comms director Ben Hope said in a statement that “We are aware and investigating reports of users experiencing issues with Microsoft 365 services, primarily issues with Exchange Online. We appreciate our customers’ patience while we work to restore services as soon as possible.”

Several hours later, Microsoft has gone through several variations of update notes regarding the issues and its attempts to fix them, saying it’s had problems rebooting servers and being able to monitor their health. As of about 6PM ET, Microsoft has a note saying it’s managed to get some of the affected servers running:

We’ve begun returning a portion of the affected servers to service, and they’re remaining stable so far. We’ve also shifted traffic and connections to alternative pathways wherever possible and have observed limited recovery in some regions.

We’ve streamlined our recovery process to expedite returning the remaining affected servers to service. To further support recovery, we’re implementing protective traffic management measures in a specific location to reduce load on the affected infrastructure, and we’ll expand these measures to additional locations if we observe positive results. As capacity is restored, users may experience a gradual recovery as their clients reconnect to the service.

There’s still no ETA for full restoration, but we will continue to monitor this ongoing outage.

items.content:
도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령이 젠슨 황의 뒤를 이을 엔비디아 CEO로 팀 쿡 전 애플 CEO를 공개 추천했다. 엔비디아가 외부 전문업체와 함께 정식 후임자를 찾고 있는 가운데, 이안 벅과 르네 하스 등 반도체 업계 인사들도 후보로 거론되고 있다.

트럼프 대통령은 12일(현지시간) 트루스소셜을 통해 쿡 전 CEO를 엔비디아의 차기 수장으로 추천했다. "훌륭한 일을 해 온 젠슨 황이 사임한 지금, 그를 대신할 사람은 애플의 팀 쿡뿐"이라며 "전설이 전설을 대신한다"라고 밝혔다.

쿡은 지난 9월 15년간 맡아 온 애플 CEO에서 물러나 현재 이사회 집행의장을 맡고 있다. 2011년 스티브 잡스의 뒤를 이어 애플을 이끌었으며, 트럼프 대통령과도 긴밀한 관계를 유지해 왔다. 그러나 엔비디아가 쿡을 실제 후임 후보로 검토하고 있다는 사실은 확인되지 않았다.

엔비디아는 외부 전문업체와 협력해 정식 CEO 후보를 물색하고 있다. 블룸버그는 11일 관계자를 인용해 엔비디아 이사회가 황 전 CEO의 퇴진에 대비해 외부 업체와 함께 후임 후보를 검토해 왔다고 보도했다.

엔비디아는 우선 콜레트 크레스 최고재무책임자(CFO)를 임시 CEO로 선임하고, 창업 초기부터 이사로 활동한 하비 존스를 초대 이사회 의장으로 임명했다. 이사회는 정식 CEO 선임을 위해 내부와 외부 후보를 모두 검토한다는 방침이다.

로이터는 주요 내부 후보로 크레스 임시 CEO와 이안 벅 부사장을 거론했다. 크레스는 2013년부터 회사의 재무와 투자 전략을 담당해 왔으며, 벅은 엔비디아의 핵심 소프트웨어 플랫폼인 쿠다(CUDA) 개발에 참여한 엔지니어 출신으로 현재 초대형 AI 인프라와 고성능 컴퓨팅 사업을 담당하고 있다.

외부에서는 르네 하스 Arm CEO가 주요 후보로 거론된다. 하스는 엔비디아에서 7년간 근무한 뒤 2013년 Arm으로 옮겼으며, 2022년 CEO에 올라 이듬해 나스닥 상장을 이끌었다. 현재 소프트뱅크그룹의 국제사업도 맡고 있어 반도체 기술과 글로벌 기업 경영 경험을 모두 갖춘 인물로 평가된다.

후임자 선정의 가장 큰 과제는 황 전 CEO가 직접 맡아 온 역할을 이어받는 것이다. 그는 33년간 반도체 기술 개발과 제품 전략뿐 아니라 주요 고객사와의 협력, AI 기업에 대한 대규모 투자까지 주도해 왔다. 이에 따라 기술 전문성과 사업 운영 능력, 재무 역량을 두루 갖춘 경영자가 필요하다는 평가가 나온다.

엔비디아는 정식 후임 CEO의 선정 일정이나 후보 명단을 공개하지 않았다. 현재 거론되는 인물들도 매체와 시장 전문가들이 제시한 후보들이다.

items.title: Xbox owners are getting more customizations for backgrounds and the Guide menu

items.content:
Xbox Insiders get to test the new features today.

Microsoft is starting to test new customization options for Xbox consoles today. Xbox Insiders will be able to start testing new rotating backgrounds, new library options for digital games, and the ability to move the Xbox Guide menu to the right-hand side.

“Xbox Insiders can now save favorite dynamic backgrounds and shuffle through them automatically,” says Eden Marie , principal software engineering lead at Xbox. “You can also choose Shuffle at the start of any background category. Have your background change each time you sign in, or set it to change hourly, daily, or weekly.”

Microsoft is also improving how you organize disc-to-digital games on an Xbox console. Xbox Insiders who have claimed a digital license from a disc-based game will be able to see these titles in a separate category in the library section. You’ll also be able to hide the digital license icon on game tiles.

Finally, Xbox Insiders will be able to choose whether the Guide menu appears on the left or right side of a screen. “Alpha Skip-Ahead members can try them first,” says Marie. “We’ll bring them to more Xbox Insiders and players over time.”

items.title: In reversal, American Cancer Society urges routine prostate cancer screening
items.summary: Men aged 50–69 and at average risk should get PSA screening every two years.
items.content:
In a significant update to its guidelines for prostate cancer screening, the American Cancer Society is now recommending that men get routinely screened for prostate cancer with a PSA test.

Men at average risk should get a PSA test every two years from age 50 to 69, according to the new guidelines released Thursday.

Men considered at high risk due to race and family history should start testing earlier, at 45, and most are recommended to get tested every year. Specifically, yearly testing starting at age 45 is recommended for all Black men, who have higher rates of prostate cancer. Non-Black men should also get yearly testing starting at 45 if a close relative was diagnosed with prostate cancer before age 65, or if more than one of their relatives has had prostate cancer. On the other hand, if only one close relative was diagnosed with prostate cancer and it was diagnosed at age 65 or older, non-Black men in this case should start PSA screening at 45, but are recommended to get testing only every two years.

Men ages 70 to 74 should consult their doctor on continuing screening, while those 75 and up are not recommended to get screened.

The new guidance departs from ACS’s previous iteration, published in 2010, which made no universal recommendations for routine screening. Men at age 50 were recommended to use shared-decision making with their doctors on whether or not to get tested. The recommendation was similar to that from the US Preventive Services Task Force , a federal panel that regularly evaluates evidence and makes recommendations on such preventive medical care. (The USPSTF is currently working on an update to its prostate cancer screening recommendation, though it should be noted that the panel has recently been overhauled by anti-vaccine Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. and new members are reportedly rife with conflicts of interest .)

In announcing the guidelines today, the ACS says its updates are based on new evidence since 2010 that shows screening saves lives , and that advances in case management can avoid the concerning harms from overdiagnosis and overtreatment. For many men with prostate cancer, their cancer will never grow or cause harm in their lifetime, while treatment can run the risk of erectile dysfunction and urinary incontinence.

In the new guidance, the ACS adds guardrails, firstly advising all men to be informed about the risks and benefits. If a PSA test comes back high—defined as 3 ng/mL or higher for men under 70 and 6.5 ng/mL or higher for those 70 and up—the ACS recommends repeating the test before taking any next steps.

If repeat testing is still high, then men should get either a prostate MRI or a validated biomarker test to assess risk. Only if there is a high suspicion of cancer—such as having a very high PSA test result—should men jump to a prostate biopsy.

For men diagnosed with prostate cancer, active surveillance should be the initial management strategy for men whose cancer appears to be at low risk of growing or spreading.

“By catching aggressive cancers with a simple PSA blood test, you open the door to highly effective treatments that protect your future,” Dr. Shanthi Sivendran, interim chief patient officer for the ACS, said in a statement. “Meanwhile, lower-risk findings can be safely managed through careful, active surveillance.”

Prostate cancer is one of the most common cancers in men and the second leading cause of cancer death in US men, the ACS notes. Nearly 334,00 men are estimated to be diagnosed with prostate cancer in 2026, and it’s estimated that over 36,320 will die from the disease.

This post was updated for clarity on November 12.

items.content:
구글이 빠른 처리 속도와 AI 에이전트 작업에 특화된 '제미나이 4 하이드로젠(Gemini 4 Hydrogen)'을 출시했다. 기존 경량 모델보다 작업 완료 속도가 2.5배 빨라졌으며, 외부 종합 성능 평가에서는 상위 모델인 '제미나이 4 아르곤'을 앞서는 성적을 기록했다.

구글은 12일(현지시간) 공식 블로그 를 통해 하이드로젠을 공개하고 구글 AI 스튜디오와 API, 제미나이 앱, 검색 등에 제공하기 시작했다고 밝혔다. 복잡한 추론에 특화된 '카본'과 아르곤에 이어 코딩과 반복적인 업무를 빠르게 처리하는 모델을 추가한 것이다.

하이드로젠은 기존 '제미나이 3.8 플래시'의 후속 모델로, 제미나이 4 카본을 기반으로 개발됐다. 최대 100만 토큰의 컨텍스트를 지원하며 텍스트와 이미지, 음성, 동영상을 입력받아 텍스트를 생성한다.

기본 최대 출력은 6만4000토큰이며, 별도의 장시간 생성 방식에서는 최대 100만 토큰까지 출력할 수 있다. 전체 매개변수와 내부 구조는 공개되지 않았다.

Google's new Gemini 4 Hydrogen has Intelligence just below Claude Sonnet 5.5 and GPT-6.1 Sol, at a third of Sonnet’s cost but ~2.5x that of GPT-6.1 Sol @GoogleDeepMind has released their third new model in six weeks. Gemini 4 Hydrogen introduces an xhigh reasoning level and… pic.twitter.com/mtn4GzkVVq

가장 주목할 만한 것은 성능이다. 아티피셜 애널리시스 종합 지능 지수(AAII)에서 기본 추론 설정인 하이(High)에서 51점을 기록해 아르곤의 50점을 넘어섰다. 최고 추론 설정인 엑스하이(Xhigh)에서는 54점까지 올라갔다. 기존 3.8 플래시의 하이 설정 31점과 비교해 성능이 크게 향상됐다.

자체 평가에서도 개선이 확인됐다. 명령줄 환경에서 소프트웨어 개발 작업을 수행하는 '터미널벤치 4.1(Terminal-Bench 4.1)'에서는 성공률 57%를 기록해 3.8 플래시의 18.2%보다 3배 이상 높았다. 작업 완료 속도는 2.5배 빨라졌으며, 사실과 다른 내용을 생성하는 비율도 5분의 1 이하로 줄었다고 밝혔다. 터미널벤치에서는 '클로드 소네트 5.5'의 63.9%에는 미치지 못했다.

기업 업무 자동화 평가인 '오토메이션벤치-AA'에서는 76.1%를 기록해 소네트 5.5의 71.8%와 'GPT-6.1 테라'의 60.2%를 앞섰다. 복잡한 전문 업무 수행 능력을 평가하는 '에이전트의 마지막 시험(ALE) 1.1'에서도 71.6%로 경쟁 모델보다 높은 점수를 기록했다.

구글은 하이드로젠을 상위 모델과 함께 사용하는 방식도 강조했다. AI 코딩 도구인 '안티그래비티'에 새로 도입한 '오케스트레이터(Orchestrator)'는 복잡한 판단이 필요할 때 카본을 사용하고, 코드 작성과 테스트 등 반복 작업에는 하이드로젠을 투입하도록 모델을 자동 전환한다.

구글에 따르면 터미널벤치 4.0에서 카본 단독 사용에 가까운 작업 성공률을 유지하면서 사용 할당량은 평균 24% 줄이고 완료 시간은 19% 단축했다. 여러 에이전트가 동시에 작업할 때도 카본이 전체 작업을 조율하고 하이드로젠이 코드 작성과 검증을 맡는 방식으로 활용할 수 있다.

에이전트의 안전성도 개선했다고 밝혔다. 기존 3.8 플래시와 비교해 에이전트가 허용된 권한을 넘어 행동하는 비율을 최대 81% 줄였으며, 도구 사용과 코딩 평가에서는 부적절한 행동과 작업 생략을 12배 줄였다는 설명이다.

로우(Low), 미디엄(Medium), 하이, 엑스하이 등 4단계 추론 수준을 제공해 작업의 난도에 따라 속도와 추론 깊이를 조절할 수 있다. 소프트웨어 개발뿐 아니라 데이터 분석과 문서 처리, 웹사이트 제작 등 다양한 에이전트 업무에 활용할 수 있다.

API 가격은 입력 토큰 100만개당 1.50달러, 출력 토큰 100만개당 7.50달러다. 기존 3.8 플래시의 현재 가격인 입력 0.75달러, 출력 3.75달러의 두 배지만, 플래시도 내년 1월부터 같은 가격이 적용될 예정이다. 아르곤과 카본의 출시 초기 가격인 입력 2달러, 출력 10달러보다는 저렴하다.

외부 평가에서도 실제 업무 처리 능력이 주목받았다. 박스(Box)의 에런 레비 CEO는 하이드로젠을 적용한 AI 에이전트의 업무 정확도가 기존 플래시의 74%에서 79%로 높아졌으며, 작업 시간은 절반 이하로 줄었다고 밝혔다. 재피어(Zapier)의 독립 평가에서도 51.1%의 작업 성공률을 기록해 상위 모델인 아르곤(51.3%)과 거의 같은 성능을 보이면서 작업당 비용은 절반 수준에 그쳤다.

items.title: Build once, run on any agent: A practical guide to agent skills
items.summary: Agent skills capture repeatable engineering work in files teams can review and reuse, while tools, project context, and permissions remain specific to the host that runs them. The post Build once, run on any agent: A practical guide to agent skills appeared first on The GitHub Bl
items.content:
How many times this week did you re-explain the same task to an agent? How many times did you ask your colleague with deep institutional knowledge how to solve a specific problem? That context shouldn’t be lost in a chat or locked in one person’s head. Agent skills let you capture repeatable instructions so you and your agents can reuse them. The skill you write for yourself tonight can later become part of a team’s pipeline.

An agent skill is a versioned directory centered on a SKILL.md file that describes when and how to do a repeatable task. You can share those instructions across agents, but the environment still needs to provide the tools, credentials, and permissions to carry them out. A skill can describe how to query a database, for example, but it doesn’t grant access to that database.

I covered this topic live with Shishir Tewari, Senior Manager, Data Engineering at Procore, during GitHub Universe 2026. Our session was titled “Build once, run on any agent: a practical guide to agent skills” .

A skill works best when it has a clear job, input, and output. For example, let’s say you’re building an agent that checks AI-generated changes against the original request. If the same agent assesses its own work, its explanation might influence the review. With Proof Agent , we use a separate verifier to examine the changes and provide evidence for its findings. The skill’s frontmatter names the task and describes its purpose:

At the center is a simple rule: self-verification is not verification.

The When to Verify section in Proof Agent’s SKILL.md says when to invoke the skill. The remaining instructions explain what the verifier reviews and what evidence to include in its findings.

When the judgment that makes a data pipeline correct lives in four different people’s heads, those four people are the roadmap. Each change to the pipeline depends on their availability and knowledge of the data. Data Forge is an example of how to capture parts of that judgment in skills that work together.

In the support-desk pipeline example , we start with a request for metrics that count incidents created and resolved. Before building the pipeline, the forge-init skill discovers details such as source tables and naming conventions, then writes them to a resolved manifest. The other skills read that manifest for the project context they need.

The forge-builder skill then coordinates the work from the issue through to a pull request. It uses forge-dbx to query the data platform and forge-lint to apply the team’s standards as it designs and builds the pipeline. A person reviews the proposed decisions along the way, and the resulting pull request contains the pipeline code, schema changes, and tests.

Each skill has a defined responsibility, and they share project context instead of rediscovering it independently. When a step changes, you can change one skill and leave the rest alone.

Skills fit bounded, repeatable work that benefits from reusable judgment, such as a checklist, release, migration, or metric pipeline. If a workflow needs a stable interface, shared state, an audit trail, long-running control, or permissions enforced outside the model, an application is a better fit.

We don’t want to hardcode every project’s names, database, or conventions into the skills. In the Data Forge support-desk example, a manifest describes the project, metric store, and platform so the skills can use the right project details without baking them into their instructions:

With the discovered details in the resolved manifest, the other skills don’t have to make their own assumptions about the project.

Keep discovered project details separate from team standards. The forge-init initialization skill can inspect existing schemas and code patterns; the forge-lint skill supplies the rules to follow before code is generated. A pattern found in a repository isn’t automatically a rule to preserve, so make discovered details reviewable and let people confirm or change them where business judgment is needed. To check portability, ask: could another team use these skills with its own manifest without rewriting them?

The forge-dbx skill gives the other Data Forge skills one way to access the data platform. It reads the manifest and selects a Databricks or DuckDB adapter, so each skill doesn’t need its own connection and query logic.

The manifest can choose DuckDB for the local support-desk demo, but it can’t install the DuckDB CLI or grant database access. Those remain setup responsibilities for the environment and its user. The manifest picks the engine; the host provides the access.

The Data Forge support-desk workflow has seven phases, with a human checkpoint at each one. The workflow overview shows how the skills fit together. Before a phase proceeds, the workflow checks that the previous phase is complete; before schema changes run, it asks for approval.

The Proof Agent example applies the same principle to code review. A GitHub Actions workflow gives the verifier the original request and code changes, but not the coding agent’s own assessment. The verifier returns PASS , FAIL , or PARTIAL and must cite evidence in the changed files. The GitHub Action does a static review of the diff; it doesn’t execute code or run tests. In the demo workflow, we set block-on-fail: false so findings were advisory. By default, a FAIL fails the check, which blocks the merge if the check is required. The aim is to keep test results and merge requirements in your repository’s CI checks and rules.

Supporting multiple clients can mean keeping several copies of the same instructions in sync. In the Data Forge example, we keep skills/*/SKILL.md as the source and use a packaging script to generate client-specific files: .claude-plugin/plugin.json for Claude Code, .cursor-plugin/plugin.json for Cursor, and .github/agents/*.agent.md for GitHub Copilot. items.summary: The limited-time offer applies to the latest phones from Google and Samsung, but you must be a new customer who signs up for 12 months of the unlimited plan.
items.content:
Unfortunately, the list of phones is limited and doesn’t include Apple’s iPhones. On the bright side, the phones aren’t low-quality; in fact, many are on our recommended lists . The unlimited plan also throttles down speeds after 50 GB per month, but it includes 20 GB for hot spot connections. Mint will offer an additional credit of $400 or more when you trade in an eligible unlocked phone (iPhone 16 or higher, Galaxy S25 or higher, Z Flip7 or Fold7 or higher, or Pixel 10 or higher).

Mint rarely offers deals or coupons because its plans are priced lower than traditional carriers, and you would have to pay full price for a new phone; while you’ll still have to shell out to cover the balance for the device, it is still more economical than the phone deals offered by the big carriers.

For more savings, check out the best Early Black Friday deals we are following.

The Google Pixel 11 is down to $399 (regularly $899) when you bundle it with the 12-month Mint unlimited plan, for a total of $579 (excluding taxes and fees). This makes the base model in the Pixel 11 series cheaper than the entry-level Pixel 10a.

Mint is also discounting the 11 Pro and 11 Pro XL to $594 and $794 , respectively (normally $1,099 and $1,299). All three Pixel 11 models are our pick for the smartest Android phones , combining great hardware, software, and Google’s Gemini AI. The Pixel 10a is our favorite Android phone overall , but Mint doesn’t offer it; otherwise, it could have been as low as $100!

Amazon (S26+, 512 GB)

Samsung fans will love that the flagship Galaxy S26 series (WIRED’s recommendation for the best flagship Android phones ) is on Mint’s discounted phones list, as is the Z Fold8, the best folding phone . Mint is offering the S26 for $500 (regularly $1,000), S26+ for $700 (regularly $1,200), and S26 Ultra for $900 (regularly $1,400). A sub-$1,000 price for the Ultra flagship is a great deal, even when you add the one year of unlimited service for $180.

The Ultra is chock-full of features, including a built-in privacy screen that sounds gimmicky but is surprisingly effective. With the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 processor, the S26-series phones are powerful devices. Samsung continues to improve its camera systems, making them some of the best in the industry. We just wish Samsung would support the Qi2 magnetic system natively for wireless charging. (They are Qi2-ready when you use a compatible case.)

If you’ve been eyeing a foldable phone, Mint has the Z Fold8 for $1,700 . This isn’t a big discount from the $1,900 regular price, but foldables aren’t cheap in general. On the Android side, this is our favorite foldable model , and it’s lightweight despite its large unfolded screen. It also offers great performance and battery life, but one downside is that it lacks a telephoto lens.

Motorola has its share of fans. If you’re one of them, Mint is discounting the Razr (our pick for the best cheap folding phone ) and Moto G Play (an honorable mention in our best Motorola phones guide ).

Mint is offering the Razr for $520 , a savings of $180. Now, that’s not a deep cut, but it is one of the more affordable foldable phones to begin with; this deal makes it even more so. Despite the budget price, we found it capable, even if the performance and battery life aren’t as strong as the Razr Ultra’s.

If you don’t care about brand or performance and just want the best phone you can buy at the lowest price, check out the Moto G Play. Mint has it for $80 (normally $250). While it isn’t one of our top picks, it’s a capable phone for casual users. And at this price, it’s worth considering.

items.title: Democrats launch Nvidia investigation, write scathing letter on Huang’s ‘scheme’ with Trump
items.summary: This Congressional investigation into Nvidia's China sales and its dealings with Trump is the second one, so far, since news of the alleged spy affair broke.
items.content:
Democrats on Thursday opened an inquiry into how the Trump administration handled Nvidia’s chip sales to China. Earlier on Thursday, the company ousted its CEO Jensen Huang . He also agreed to testify to a different set of Republican-led Congressional committees.

Huang was removed from the company he founded after he confessed to an extramarital affair with a woman accused of being a Chinese spy. (He has since been accused of having more affairs , with Nvidia employees.)

The alleged Chinese spy, Alice Huang, was an executive of Nvidia customer Megaspeed, a Singapore-based company that U.S. officials suspect of helping route advanced Nvidia chips into China. The Democratic inquiry comes from Rep. Richard Neal (D-Mass.), the top Democrat on the House Ways and Means Committee, and Sen. Ron Wyden (D-Ore.), the top Democrat on the Senate Finance Committee. As the minority party, they can ask questions but can’t compel answers.

Their humdinger of a letter to Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick asks the department to preserve records about an arrangement they find questionable and, they allege, illegal.

“The scheme worked like this,” as the letter describes it. President Trump agreed to sales of Nvidia’s H200 chips to China as long as the chips, manufactured by Taiwan, were first shipped to the United States. On arriving, Trump added a tariff “effectively taking a cut of Nvidia’s sales to China through what appears to be an unconstitutional export tax system,” the letter said. Then the Commerce Department, under Lutnick, issued an export license.

By the way, the deal between Trump and Nvidia to share revenue was public. In August 2025, Nvidia and AMD both agreed to share 15% of their revenue from chip sales to China with the U.S. government as part of a deal to secure export licenses, the AP reported at the time.

But the letter questions why Lutnick continued to allow Megaspeed to buy chips even after he was reportedly informed by U.S. intelligence of their suspicions of Alice Huang and of Jensen Huang’s relationship with her. It questions why the department reportedly green-lit other Asian companies to buy Nvidia chips “with no physical presence at their listed addresses.” So the inquiry is aimed at the administration, not just at Nvidia and Huang.

The letter also questions how Nvidia’s donations to Trump’s projects factored in. It notes that the export deal was approved after Trump learned of “Mr. Huang’s compromised position” in sleeping with an alleged spy, and after Nvidia donated $26 million toward Trump’s projects, including the ballroom. It appears to be asking if Trump used his knowledge of the affair to secure donations from Nvidia.

Interestingly, in a “60 Minutes” interview with President Trump that aired on Sunday, Trump mentioned how he and his team had threatened an unnamed AI exec with jail , and after that, the exec “totally changed.”

This Congressional investigation into Nvidia’s China sales and its dealings with Trump is the second one, so far, since news of the alleged spy affair broke. The Republican-led group involves leaders from the House Select Committee on the Chinese Communist Party, the House Committee on Foreign Affairs, and the House Intelligence Committee. That group has demanded that Huang come to them and testify in a closed-door session. They had threatened to subpoena him if he didn’t voluntarily agree. On Thursday, after his resignation, he agreed.

items.title: Silicon Valley Is Still Defending Jensen Huang
items.summary: Nvidia employees and tech insiders never thought the chip king would lose his job. Despite his sudden resignation, many of them are still in denial.
items.content:
News of Jensen Huang’s affair with an alleged asset of China’s Ministry of State Security was first met with a muted response in Silicon Valley —including inside Nvidia itself. Huang’s resignation , after news of two other alleged romantic relationships with Nvidia staffers, has left both the company and the broader AI industry stunned .

As revelations about Huang’s initial affair came out earlier this week, rank-and-file Nvidia employees at first pursued business as usual, according to two current and three former employees at the chipmaker, speaking anonymously to protect relationships at the company. They trusted the board to investigate and act accordingly, but few workers thought Huang would actually leave.

Nvidia’s roughly 60,000 employees are loyal to the point that its global turnover rate is reportedly among the lowest in tech. Workers say they have heard it called having “green in your blood” or being “green-pilled” or on “team green,” referring to the company’s signature color. Huang was the company’s soul and the founder who stuck with it through challenges for 33 years. Employees appreciated that he kept layoffs rare and red tape sparing.

“In just three days we went from superhero cape to ‘Oops, I forgot my pants,’ and nobody’s quite sure how to swallow that,” one employee said. One former employee insisted in Huang’s defense that something “more sinister” must have been in play, and that affairs alone shouldn’t have led to his departure.

Huang’s peers in Silicon Valley echoed that sentiment, remaining vocal in their support of the embattled CEO even after his ouster. “One mistake does not erase a lifetime of leadership and contribution in building NVDA,” venture capitalist Antonio Gracias wrote on X earlier this week, using the company’s ticker symbol.

The New York Times reported on Wednesday that Huang has also had an extramarital affair with a vice president at Nvidia, and Reuters revealed on Thursday a second “intimate relationship” with an employee. Before those alleged affairs became public, multiple industry executives told WIRED that Huang is “irreplaceable” and that his biggest mistake, aside from his relationship with Alice Huang, was admitting the affair in writing to the whole company.

That appears to still be the prevailing sentiment. “A founder who has spent 30 years building such a unique company so capably has earned the presumption that he should keep leading it,” venture capitalist Sarah Guo wrote on X after Huang resigned, and a few hours before the Reuters report.

Authorities and Nvidia’s board have yet to formally accuse Huang of wrongdoing in his interactions with the businesswoman and suspected intelligence asset Alice Huang, and China has denied that she’s a spy. President Donald Trump said on Tuesday that the FBI “is looking into it.” Nvidia’s board has stated that it doesn’t believe Huang compromised any secrets, but it has hired the law firm Wachtell Lipton to investigate.

Add to all that, some corners of Nvidia had already been whispering about the relationship with Alice Huang; one venture capitalist who declined to be named recalled a recent dinner where an Nvidia executive claimed there had been rumors about Jensen’s romantic relationship with a young Asian woman.

On Monday, the venture capitalist had estimated a “less than 10 percent” chance Huang would lose his job at the top of the world’s most valuable company. “The wind’s going to blow over on this,” they said. “People are going to hate him for three months, and forget this ever happened.”

Huang’s resignation left them in shock.

The big anxiety in Silicon Valley remains the possibility that instability at Nvidia will burst an AI bubble, but analysts aren’t so sure.

The chief executive of one AI company, who spoke on condition of anonymity so as not to affect business relationships, says Nvidia’s recent bankrolling of AI startups and even buying companies such as model-hosting provider Hugging Face has helped prop up the need for chips. A “new professional CEO won’t do any of that,” meaning “systemic risk for the AI trade and AI bubble increases substantially,” the entrepreneur says.

Between bubble talk and Huang rumors, Nvidia shares in recent days have sunk to their lowest point in more than a year. Nvidia reports its latest quarterly earnings next week.

Inside Nvidia, meetings, projects, and the company’s aggressive culture are rapidly pressing ahead with what’s left of Huang’s vision.

Additional reporting by Will Knight and Zoë Schiffer.

items.title: FAA expands AI advice to manage air traffic congestion across entire US airspace
items.summary: Airlines praised the AI tool, but the air traffic controllers’ union wasn’t involved.
items.content:
The US government has expanded the use of an AI tool for advising air traffic controllers to assist in managing air traffic across the entire national airspace system. Airline executives have voiced support for the rollout, but the US labor union representing air traffic controllers has said it was not involved in designing or testing the AI-driven system.

The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) says the $875 million SMART system has helped reroute 180 flights since being implemented in airspace over Washington, DC, on September 21. The agency claims that this saved an average of 10 minutes per flight and almost 80 gallons of fuel per flight—and it is apparently hoping such results can be replicated nationwide through the expanded deployment.

“After a successful initial rollout to the National Capital Region in September, the FAA will now use SMART in the airspace of all 22 centers across the country to reduce delays, reduce fuel consumption and improve the travel experience for the flying public,” according to the agency statement posted on November 10.

The FAA fact sheet describes SMART as a cloud-based system that combines information about “weather patterns, flight paths, traffic flow and controller staffing metrics” to predict air traffic patterns. It is designed to make scheduling recommendations, identify optimal flight routes, and determine the best order of arrivals for aircraft.

However, a human team of FAA specialists based in DC is ultimately responsible for validating the SMART system recommendations before passing them along to air traffic control facilities across the country, according to the agency.

Furthermore, the AI-powered SMART system “cannot be used to replace the critical role air traffic controllers play or take over control of an aircraft,” the FAA clarified in the September 21 announcement about the initial deployment. Local air traffic controllers can decide whether or not to accept the SMART system recommendations.

The previous FAA announcement included supportive statements from Delta Air Lines CEO Ed Bastian and American Airlines CEO Robert Isom.

But the National Air Traffic Controllers Association, which represents more than 15,000 members, also told Flying magazine that it was not consulted or involved in the “design, testing, or implementation of SMART and therefore cannot speak to its effect on the air traffic control workforce.”

Following the initial deployment in airspace above DC, the FAA expanded the SMART system’s coverage to air route traffic control centers in Atlanta along with Jacksonville and Miami in Florida, according to The Dallas Morning News .

The FAA also shared an example with The Dallas Morning News about how SMART recommended a shorter and faster route for a cargo flight arriving at Dallas-Fort Worth International Airport, although the newspaper noted that the agency did not identify the flight involved and has not provided information about how SMART may have assisted passenger flight traffic.

Ars has previously covered the SMART system’s development and lingering questions about how it works, as well as the air traffic controller shortage and other challenges facing the FAA.

items.title: Muse can now place calls to US businesses — if you pay
items.summary: Muse's AI can now place outbound calls to U.S. businesses — but it's not free.
items.content:
Meta’s Muse, which now has over 10 million users , the company said last month, has been working to make consumer AI a mainstream product for everyday users. Placing calls is one of the ways it aims to get there, as it could handle another task on people’s to-do lists.

Notes Alexandr Wang, Meta’s chief AI officer and head of its Superintelligence Labs division, the feature could be used to take care of calls people don’t want to make, like those to their cable company, the DMV, or to a restaurant that doesn’t offer online reservations.

🚨MUSE FEATURE ALERT!!!🚨 lots of you have been asking for this one… muse can make phone calls for you! ☎️📞📲 let muse take care of all those calls you don’t want to make. insurance? cable? DMV? dinner res? not your problem anymore. out now to paid subs in the US 🇺🇸 pic.twitter.com/dsyMNmI2Ub

Previously, only a select number of Muse early adopters were able to try this feature after asking the AI for access. Now, anyone who pays for Muse can make this type of request. Currently, Muse subscription plans start at $20 per month for 500 million Muse tokens per week. Heavier AI users can opt to pay $100 per month for 3 billion tokens.

Muse is not the only AI agent able to place calls to businesses; the startup Instinct has been offering a similar option , as has Google’s Gemini . However, while the AI tools are now certainly capable of handling the task, the reception on the other end of the line can be mixed. Many businesses and receptionists hang up on calls from AI agents as soon as they identify that it’s not a human on the phone. But with AI now better able to mimic a real human voice, being able to tell the difference between a customer and an AI working on the customer’s behalf will get tougher.

Despite the challenges, this feature is one that could appeal to consumers who have grown frustrated with the state of customer service over the years. For too long, customers have been forced to navigate complex phone trees, and then sit on hold waiting for a human representative to pick up. If they’re lucky, that person can actually help them, and not transfer them to another department. Now, those consumers could potentially use their AI, with its infinite patience, for this tedious task instead.

While calls remain a paid-only feature for the time being, the recently added option to make a Muse email address will soon roll out to free users, Wang said this week.

items.content:
2027년이 AI 발전의 중대한 전환점이 될 것이라는 전망이 이어지고 있습니다. 올봄부터 오픈AI와 앤트로픽 내부에서 제기됐던 급격한 기술 발전에 대한 경고가 하반기에는 외부 평가기관의 분석으로 이어지면서, 당시 발언들이 무엇을 의미했는지 조금씩 드러나고 있습니다.

지난해 'AI 2027' 시나리오 로 화제를 모았던 AI 퓨처스 프로젝트(AI Futures Project)는 10일 새로운 분석 을 발표하고, 인간 최고 수준의 연구자를 능가하는 AI가 2027년에 등장할 가능성이 높다고 전망했습니다.

특히, 내년 한 해 동안 과거 4~5년 치에 해당하는 기술 발전이 이뤄질 수 있다는 예측이 눈길을 끕니다.

연구진 6명 모두 초인간 AI 연구자(SAR)가 내년에 등장할 가능성을 높게 평가했습니다. 인간 최고 전문가를 능가하며 사무직 업무 전반을 자동화할 수 있는 TED-AI(Top-Expert-Dominating AI)가 2027년 말까지 등장할 확률도 35~65%로 추정했습니다. 기존 'AI 2027' 시나리오에서 예상했던 연구개발 가속이 실제로는 약 5개월 먼저 나타났다는 분석입니다.

이런 전망의 근거는 지난 5일 독립 AI 평가기관 METR이 발표한 연구 결과 입니다. METR은 11주 동안 앤트로픽의 내부 연구자료와 비공개 모델 3종의 성능 등을 분석해, AI 모델 발전 속도가 이전보다 약 1.9배 빨라졌다고 추정했습니다. 과거 2년 동안 이뤘던 기술 발전을 최근 1년 만에 달성한 셈입니다. AI 퓨처스 프로젝트는 이를 반영해 현재 AI 개발 가속 효과 중 약 80%가 AI 자체의 연구개발 기여에서 나왔을 가능성이 있다고 분석했습니다.

AI가 차세대 AI 개발에 참여하고, 그렇게 만들어진 AI가 다시 후속 모델을 개선하는 재귀적 자기 개선(RSI)이 본격화되면 발전 속도는 훨씬 빨라질 수 있습니다. AI 퓨처스 프로젝트가 주목한 것도 AI가 연구개발을 완전히 자동화하기 전에 이미 상당한 가속이 나타났다는 사실입니다.

AI 기업 내부에서는 올해 초부터 이런 변화에 대한 경고가 나왔습니다. 앤트로픽은 6월 AI가 차세대 모델 개발에 참여하는 비중이 빠르게 늘고 있다고 밝혔습니다. 7월에는 오픈AI와 앤트로픽, 구글 딥마인드 등의 직원 1300여명이 AI 발전이 인간의 통제를 넘어설 위험이 있다며 공동 성명을 발표했습니다.

9월에는 오픈AI 수석과학자 야쿠프 파초키 가 내부 연구 결과를 근거로 RSI 가능성을 언급했습니다. 같은 달 앤트로픽 연구원 제이컵 콕슨 은 오픈AI와 앤트로픽이 스스로를 개선하는 초지능 개발을 놓고 경쟁하고 있다며 회사를 떠났습니다. 오픈AI와 구글 딥마인드, 앤트로픽 등의 전·현직 연구원 22명 도 공개 인터뷰를 통해 AI의 재귀적 자기 개선이 인간의 통제를 벗어날 위험이 있다고 경고했습니다.

당시만 해도 이런 경고는 쉽게 와닿지 않았습니다. 일반 이용자들이 접하는 AI는 여전히 엉뚱한 답변을 내놓거나 코딩 작업에서 오류를 일으켰습니다. 기업들이 공개하지 않은 최첨단 모델의 성능도 외부에서는 확인하기 어려웠습니다.

그러나 하반기 들어 외부 평가기관에서도 잇달아 비슷한 분석이 나왔습니다. AI 평가업체 발스 AI(Vals AI) 는 9월 앤트로픽이 2027년 7월 완전한 RSI에 도달할 수 있다고 예측했습니다. 10월에는 라얀 크리슈난 CEO 가 인터뷰에서 이 전망을 재확인했습니다. 이어 METR은 비공개 모델까지 분석해 실제 발전 속도가 약 1.9배 빨라졌다는 결과를 내놓았습니다.

이처럼 최근의 경고와 분석은 하나의 가능성으로 집중되고 있습니다. 바로 2027년, AI가 스스로의 개발을 가속하면서 지금까지와는 다른 수준의 '지능 폭발'이 시작될 수 있다는 것입니다.

AI 발전이 실제로 언제 폭발적인 가속 단계에 들어설지는 알 수 없습니다. 그러나 AI 기업 내부에서 시작된 경고가 외부의 관측 결과와 맞물리면서, 2027년이 중대한 전환점이 될 수 있다는 전망에 힘이 실리고 있습니다.

올봄과 여름에는 다소 먼 미래처럼 들렸던 이야기가 이제는 구체적인 수치와 연결되고 있습니다. 불과 두 달 앞으로 다가온 2027년에는 과연 어떤 일이 벌어질지 주목됩니다.

■ 구글, '제미나이 4 카본' 정식 출시…'페이블 5.2'의 4분의 1 가격

구글이 최상위 모델 '제미나이 4 카본'을 정식 출시하면서, 최근 종합 성능 1위를 차지한 앤트로픽의 '클로드 페이블 5.2'보다 API 가격을 75% 낮게 책정했습니다. 성능 경쟁에서 한발 밀렸지만 실제 업무 수행 능력과 비용 효율성을 앞세워 기업용 AI 시장 공략에 나선 것입니다.

■ 디 인포메이션 "젠슨 황 인맥으로 엔비디아 칩 10조원 규모 중국 공급"

중국 여성 사업가가 황 CEO와의 친분을 활용해 10조원 규모의 엔비디아 AI 칩을 중국에 공급했다는 의혹이 제기됐습니다. H100·H200 등 24만개의 칩이 중국으로 흘러간 것으로 알려지면서, 논란은 개인적인 문제를 넘어 미국의 수출통제 문제로 번지고 있습니다.

■ '페이블 5.2' 프롬프트 가이드 공개…"코드 맡기면 정리 5배 증가"

페이블 5.2에 "이 코드베이스는 당신의 것"이라는 문장 하나를 추가하자 중복 코드를 정리하는 비율이 10% 미만에서 약 50%로 높아졌습니다. 지시 방식에 따라 AI가 다르게 행동할 수 있다는 것으로, 모델 성능만큼이나 작업 지침을 어떻게 설계하느냐가 중요하다는 점을 보여줍니다.

items.content:
Many prominent voices in technology and the president of the US have publicly supported the former Nvidia CEO despite his ouster.﻿

Nvidia announced this morning that Jensen Huang has resigned as CEO following reports of two affairs, including one with an alleged Chinese spy and one with a direct report. The situation surrounding Huang has unfolded quickly, with The New York Times only reporting on Friday that Huang and the suspected spy were “close” before other dominoes started to fall, leading to a swift fall from grace for one of the biggest names in technology. (Hours after Huang’s resignation was announced, Reuters reported that he also had an “intimate relationship” with another Nvidia employee.)

Prominent voices in technology have come out in support of Huang, with some calling the resignation a “waste” and a sad day for “all humanity.” The narrative among those leaders on X, at least, is that Huang’s resignation was rushed — perhaps an overreaction to salacious news stories about his personal life. Some others have had a more neutral reaction, commenting more on Huang’s achievements at the company’s helm. You can see a collection of those responses below.

“NOW THAT Nvidia CEO JENSEN HUANG, who has done a fantastic job, has resigned, there is only one man to take his place - TIM COOK of Apple. A Legend replaces a Legend!”, Trump said on Truth Social .

Elon Musk said in a reply to an X user that it would “be an honor” to hire Huang. He also replied to a post that said “You’d think we’d have learned from Steve Jobs and Travis Kalanick that one does not just simply replace the founder…” by saying “True words.”

Sweeney said that today is “A sad day for NVIDIA, developers, America, and all humanity. Jensen founded and ran one of the few companies to reach a massive scale while driving massive continued innovation and ubiquity, while others fell into the trap of ever-increasing extraction.”

Ahead of Huang’s resignation, Sweeney posted about how Huang “saved” a GDC 2015 presentation by dropping off a graphics card and said that “The dude truly is the visionary driver of the future of tech from the gaming GPU era to CUDA to AI supercomputers.”

“China wants Jensen out, so I want him in,” Luckey said last night, before Huang’s resignation was announced.

Mullenweg reposted an X post that followed his brief September ouster as CEO : “Founder advice: If you don’t have a coup attempt every few years, you’re not hiring strong enough leaders.” He said , “Just putting this back out there, for no reason whatsoever.”

“What a waste,” Hansson said this morning , replying to his own post from hours before : “NVIDIA would be wrong to fire Jensen. His marital indiscretions are between him, his wife, and a reprimand from the board. Have some proportionality.”

“This whole thing sucks, and I wish none of it had happened,” Delangue said . “It’s a really sad day! But I want to make one thing clear: we’ll keep fighting for open-source AI, harder than ever. This is too important to slow down now. Let’s go!

“It’s a mistake for Nvidia to let Jensen resign,” Zhao said .

“If that Spy’s goal was to destabilize one of the most successful American companies, they achieved their goal,” Steinberger said . “Ousting Jensen feels rushed and not right.” (“I agree,” replied Sweeney .)

items.title: The unfolding Jensen Huang scandal: a timeline
items.summary: Jensen Huang has resigned from Nvidia following an affair, which could have ramifications for national security as the U.S. and China race to develop the most advanced AI infrastructure.
items.content:
Nvidia co-founder and now former CEO Jensen Huang has never been as flashy or controversy-prone as AI leaders like OpenAI’s Sam Altman or SpaceXAI’s Elon Musk. Now, the 63-year-old industry kingpin has admitted that he cheated on his wife of 40 years in affairs that could have ramifications beyond Huang’s personal life and U.S. national security.

U.S. officials believe that one of Huang’s likely romantic interests, Megaspeed executive Alice Huang, is a Chinese spy who has been feeding information back to Beijing. (Alice Huang, a Chinese citizen, is of no relation to Jensen Huang.)

Megaspeed is a Singapore-based AI infrastructure company that reportedly purchased $4.8 billion in Nvidia chips over the last two years. The U.S. and Singapore have both previously investigated Megaspeed over suspicions that the firm was illegally sharing chips with China. The Justice Department has since taken over the federal investigation into the company, The New York Times has reported.

The story took a sudden new turn on Wednesday. Citing five people who worked at Nvidia, the Times reported that Huang also had an extramarital relationship with Kimberly Powell, the company’s vice president of healthcare, who reports directly to him. Nvidia, Huang, and Powell have not confirmed the report. Reached by a Times reporter, Huang reportedly said, “I don’t think you should be talking to me directly,” before hanging up.

By early Thursday morning, Huang was no longer CEO of the company he co-founded 33 years ago. Then, Thursday afternoon, Reuters dropped another bombshell, publishing a report alleging that Huang had yet another extramarital affair with another unnamed Nvidia employee.

The U.S. and China are embroiled in a fierce technological arms race to build the most advanced AI infrastructure, which could shape each country’s economic future, military prowess, and capacity for innovation. Nvidia is valuable in this competition as one of the world’s largest makers of AI chips, which are essential for accelerating AI development. But as an American company, Nvidia faces government restrictions on the sale of its most powerful chips to Chinese entities.

As the controversy unfolds, we are organizing the most relevant events into a reverse-chronological timeline to keep you up to date.

After Huang was already ousted from Nvidia, we continued to learn more incriminating claims about the former CEO. According to Reuters, Huang had a third affair with an additional unnamed employee of Nvidia.

Nvidia confirmed in an SEC filing on Thursday that the board accepted Huang’s resignation on Wednesday. The company’s current CFO, Colette Kress , will take over as interim CEO while still fulfilling her CFO duties. Nvidia is expected to conduct a larger search to determine a permanent successor to Huang.

Harvey C. Jones, a managing partner of Square Wave Ventures and former CEO of Synopsys, was appointed as the company’s first-ever chair of the board of directors. Jones has been on Nvidia’s board since 1993.

Later in the day, Huang confirmed that he would testify in Congress at some point before Thanksgiving, which falls on November 26.

“Jensen and I have been very at odds as some of you already know on export controls, but Nvidia is a very important company to the United States of America,” House Foreign Affairs Committee Chairman Brian Mast said to reporters. “I don’t want to see anything hurt in Nvidia, but he has some very serious questions to answer.”

The testimony is expected to take place behind closed doors, but Mast believes the briefing will be recorded and transcribed.

After reports of a second extramarital affair, Nvidia’s board reportedly plans to meet to discuss Huang’s future at the company, per The Wall Street Journal. Stock fell about 8% in after-hours trading on Wednesday and is down 11% in the past five days.

Huang famously delegates very little and has about 60 direct reports, he has said . The company has not had an obvious successor or a succession plan.

The New York Times reported that Jensen Huang also had an affair with Nvidia vice president of healthcare Kimberly Powell, who reports directly to the CEO.

According to the report, Huang and Powell were captured on film “being affectionate” at a hotel during a conference earlier this year.

Huang has not responded to a request from three Republican congressman to appear for a closed-door briefing for questioning about his affair with an alleged Chinese spy. House China committee Chairman Moolenaar said Wednesday on Fox Business that if Huang doesn’t agree to the briefing, he’ll likely be subpoenaed .

The Nvidia CEO pulled out of upcoming speaking engagements at the ElevenLabs Summit and Anthropic CEO Forum.

Alice Huang and her family reportedly built a network of companies in China and Singapore to acquire Nvidia chips, including founding a Chinese company called Shanghai Century Litong. Founded in 2023, it became an Nvidia-preferred cloud partner, giving it priority access to chips, The Information reported . The Information also reported that Shanghai Century Litong facilitated buying $7.5 billion worth of Nvidia’s chips, including banned chips.

Nvidia’s head lawyer, Tim Teter, intervened in a 2025 U.S. government probe surrounding the suspected smuggling of AI chips by Megaspeed International, Bloomberg reported . Teter contacted Commerce Under Secretary Jeffrey Kessler asking questions about whether the Trump administration played a role in detaining Alice Huang.

In early 2025, Alice Huang and a business partner sought China-based investors for an Asian data center, promising they had no problem in securing GPUs, the Financial Times reported.

On Sunday night, President Trump weighed in on Huang’s controversy and showed support for the Nvidia CEO.

“I have not spoken to him about it. I just know he’s a fine person, but you never know what’s going on,” Trump said.

items.content:
미국이 중국 기업의 첨단 AI 반도체 접근을 차단하기 위해 해외 데이터센터의 GPU 임대까지 규제하는 방안을 추진하고 있다. 젠슨 황 엔비디아 CEO의 사임으로 규제 강화 가능성이 커지자, 중국 AI 기업들은 해외 컴퓨팅 자원 확보를 서두르는 것으로 알려졌다.

디 인포메이션은 11일(현지시간) 사안에 정통한 관계자 2명을 인용해 미국 상무부가 중국 AI 기업의 해외 데이터센터 원격 접근을 제한하는 규정을 마무리하고 있다고 보도했다. 이르면 이달 중 발표될 수 있으며, 현재 다른 정부 부처들과 협의 중인 것으로 전해졌다.

새 규정은 싱가포르와 말레이시아, 태국, 인도네시아, 브라질, 노르웨이, 남아프리카공화국 등 7개국에 대한 첨단 AI 반도체 수출 통제를 강화하는 내용을 담고 있다. 엔비디아의 '블랙웰' 및 이후 세대 반도체가 대상으로, 해당 국가에 첨단 AI 반도체를 수출하려면 미국 정부의 허가를 받아야 한다.

핵심은 중국 기업이 해외에 설치된 엔비디아 GPU를 원격으로 사용하는 경로까지 차단하려는 것이다. 미국은 그동안 중국에 대한 최첨단 AI 반도체의 직접 수출을 제한해 왔지만, 중국 기업들은 싱가포르와 말레이시아 등 해외 데이터센터에서 GPU 연산 능력을 임대해 중국으로 반도체를 들여오지 않고도 AI 모델을 학습하거나 운영할 수 있었다.

새 규정에 따라 해당 국가의 데이터센터 사업자는 반도체 수령자와 사용 목적을 미국 상무부에 신고하고 지속적인 감독을 받아야 한다. 미국 기업이 운영하는 데이터센터는 중국 등 미국의 무기 금수 대상국에 대한 원격 접근을 차단하면 수출 허가를 면제받을 수 있지만, 고객 정보와 연산 자원 규모 등을 보고해야 한다.

이어 로이터는 12일 관계자 3명을 인용해 중국 AI 기업들이 규제 시행에 앞서 해외 엔비디아 GPU 연산 자원을 확보하려는 움직임을 보인다고 보도했다.

중국의 한 대형 클라우드 업체는 해외 엔비디아 GPU 사용 용량을 미리 확보하는 방안을 내부적으로 논의했으며, 일부 기업들은 데이터센터 운영업체에 연산 자원 예약을 문의한 것으로 알려졌다. 소규모 AI 개발사들도 동남아시아의 GPU 임대업체들과 접촉하는 방안을 검토하고 있다. 실제 계약 체결 여부와 확보 규모는 확인되지 않았다.

미국 의회도 해외 GPU 원격 사용을 규제하기 위한 입법을 추진하고 있다. '원격 접근 보안법(Remote Access Security Act)'은 중국 기업이 해외 클라우드 서비스를 통해 수출 제한 대상 기술을 이용하는 행위까지 상무부가 규제할 수 있도록 하는 내용이다. 지난 1월 하원을 통과했으며 현재 상원 심의를 기다리고 있다.

이러한 규제 강화 움직임은 황 전 CEO와 중국 정보기관 연계 의혹을 받는 여성의 관계가 드러나고, 그가 사임한 이후 힘을 얻고 있다. 그는 중국 시장에 대한 AI 반도체 판매 허용을 적극 주장해 왔지만, 최근 중국으로의 첨단 반도체 밀반출 의혹이 불거지면서 미국 의회에서는 수출 통제를 강화해야 한다는 목소리가 커지고 있다.

엔비디아는 지난 7월 원격 접근 보안법이 시행되면 자사 사업에 중대한 영향을 미칠 수 있다고 밝힌 바 있다. 디 인포메이션은 엔비디아가 그동안 해외 데이터센터에 대한 규제 강화에 반대해 왔다며, 이번 규정 추진이 워싱턴에서 엔비디아의 영향력이 약해지고 있음을 보여줄 수 있다고 분석했다.

items.title: Nebius tests the neocloud playbook with $40 billion in planned spending
items.summary: Nebius plans to fund its $40 billion AI infrastructure expansion through customer prepayments and loans, even as delays at a Microsoft data center raise questions about its financing model.
items.content:
In its third-quarter earnings call Thursday, the neocloud company Nebius laid out $40 billion in planned spending for 2027, far more than Wall Street had expected. It’s an ambitious plan, but it rests on a string of planned projects that are already starting to show cracks.

Nebius plans to fund the buildout by relying on customer pre-payments and loans backed by customer contracts — essentially using the future value of its data centers to finance their construction. But that can be a risky strategy if those projects get bogged down by delays or cancellations.

“Building at this scale is hard, and delays are part of our industry right now,” CEO Arkady Volozh said during Thursday’s earnings call. “We are not immune.”

The earnings announcement comes on the heels of reports that Microsoft is cooling on neocloud deals that aren’t delivering on time. That’s a problem for companies like Nebius, whose financing strategy is becoming more dependent on repayments. Because if it can’t get to capacity on time, it will keep piling on costs while revenues slip.

One of Nebius’s largest customers is Microsoft, which is paying for AI computing capacity at a Vineland, New Jersey data center that is now months behind schedule. Nebius’s contract with Microsoft is worth up to $19.4 billion, but it’s already letting deadlines slip. Only just over half of the Microsoft capacity is now planned for delivery by the end of the year, with the rest coming in Q2 2027.

The delay is because DataOne, the third party operator of the site, “decided to wind down the temporary generation faster than it was expected,” according to Andrey Korolenko, chief product and infrastructure officer, as the site switches over to Bloom Energy fuel cells.

Still, that transition wasn’t entirely by choice. In August , the investigative site Floodlight identified at least 45 natural gas generators in operation at the DataOne site, even though it had not received any permits for operating gas generators. New Jersey regulators fined the DataOne facility $1.1 million in response, finding that the use of the generators violated federal law.

DataOne is also facing a noise-complaint lawsuit from nearby residents over a constant humming noise allegedly emitted by the data center.

According to Nebius’s summary of its Microsoft contract, Microsoft can terminate affected service after a grace period if dates are missed and no alternative capacity is offered. The tranches were originally meant to be deployed in 2025 and 2026, so a Q2 2027 delivery date falls well beyond that window. The contract also includes financial penalties for late delivery.

Nebius said that Microsoft “has been part of the planning process.” Nebius did not say whether Microsoft has agreed to the new dates, but Microsoft has not publicly canceled anything.

TechCrunch has reached out to Nebius, Microsoft, and DataOne for comment.

On the call, Marc Boroditsky, Nebius’s chief revenue officer said the company’s deals with Microsoft and Meta both came with significant prepayment, which arrived long before delivery. But Bloomberg reported last week that Microsoft is tightening oversight on projects run by third parties, including Nebius, IREN, and Nscale, and debating whether it’s worth signing new agreements. Microsoft also sent employees to the site in New Jersey, per Bloomberg.

In its own quarterly earnings report, Microsoft noted that its capex spend was lower than expected due to third-party delays. The company is clearly not above pulling back from planned agreements where its partner doesn’t meet its share of the bargain. Bloomberg also reported that Microsoft won’t use an option to more than double its Nscale agreement for a Texas data center and recently stopped being an anchor customer for Nscale’s planned Essex site after power delays.

Nebius says the delays it faces are coming from sites it doesn’t control, with the data centers it is building itself coming online on time or ahead of schedule. Those, Nebius says, will supply most of its new capacity from 2027. New deals signed in Q3 came with prepayments that more than cover the cost of building capacity behind them, says Boroditsky. Nebius ended the quarter with $7.4 billion in cash.

Total prepayments plus asset-backed financing of investment-grade contracts are expected to cover up to 85% of the $40 to $45 billion 2027 capex spend. CFO Maria Del Dado Alonso Sanchez named Microsoft and Meta as contracts that can be financed this way. Boroditsky also said Nebius could “tap prepayments to shore up any additional cash requirements.”

Nebius forecast 2027 revenue of $12 to $13 billion, and said it expects to break even on a pre-tax basis by the fourth quarter.

Nebius reported third-quarter revenue of $981 million, up 571% from a year earlier. Roughly a third of that was a one-time payment tied to a new partnership model. Nebius cut its 2026 revenue forecast by $200 million to $3 billion, citing delays to third-party sites like New Jersey. Shares ended the day down 17%.
